recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14206 unless a future work group decision deliberately narrows Basic.author target profiles.
issue_request: FHIR-14206 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested opening Basic.author to allow Organization as an author when a Basic resource is created by an organization rather than a specific individual.
initial_application: The Jira comment records application in svn revision 13040. The mirrored git commit a2956afa39c1eafeda0aba522d4057a48c2de697, 'GF#14206 - add Organization to Basic.author', changed the then-authoritative source/basic/basic-spreadsheet.xml author type from Reference(Practitioner|Patient|RelatedPerson) to Reference(Practitioner|Patient|RelatedPerson|Organization). Later source refactors moved Basic into structuredefinition-Basic.xml and preserved the Organization target.
additional_context: Basic is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/basic/structuredefinition-Basic.xml is current build-scope source. The current Basic.author target list includes Organization and later expansions such as Device and CareTeam. FHIR-32981 is a later same-element Device expansion and already has a combined-branch audit commit, so it was not duplicated here. Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no human discussion or later decision contradicting the Organization allowance.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source already satisfies FHIR-14206 by allowing Basic.author to reference Organization.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive request to add Device to the same Basic.author target list; already represented on the combined branch and not republished here.
